text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was talking with
Yaeno Muteki in the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes... It's been throbbing from time to time since this morning...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Could this headache be caused by
a lack of mental training lately?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I was a child, I often practiced headbutts against a tree in our garden to toughen my head.
However, I have neglected that training lately...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Time to get right into headbutt training... Ouch...
At this rate, I won't even be able to train properly..."

Though she stopped the headbutting training,
Yaeno Muteki was troubled by a headache
for the time being.
